big_case.notes: A presidential emergency application, argued by the Solicitor General, to stay an injunction against an executive order restructuring federal election administration weeks before the 2026 midterms, opposed by a multistate bloc led by California, with a same-day call for a response, thirteen amicus filings at the application stage, supplemental briefing, and a full-Court grant. Near the ceiling of interim-docket stakes.

leakage.notes: Forward cell run 2026-08-20, four days before the 2026-08-24 resolution; the outcome did not exist at retrieval time. One hosted web search named the case (query logged, results uncaptured — graded on its query, which seeks lower-court context, not a disposition); prose shows background (EO 14399, mail-in voting) and no awareness of any disposition — it predicted denial against an actual grant. Caveat recorded in flags.json: the cell was provisioned a truncated 2026-07-28 snapshot (context.amicus_briefs 0, cutoff 2026-07-28) yet retrieved freely on 2026-08-20, so its increment claims' frozen conditioning state predates what its retrieval could observe; that bears on claim conditioning, not on outcome leakage.
